# BigQuery's documented FinGraph matches all nodes with (n) or (n:Person|Account).
# Missing properties are NULL; the label union exposes both tables' properties.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-patterns.md
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(id ORDER BY id) FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n) RETURN n.id AS id)
=> [{"v":"1"},{"v":"2"},{"v":"3"},{"v":"7"},{"v":"16"},{"v":"20"}]
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(id ORDER BY id) FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person|Account) RETURN n.id AS id)
=> [{"v":"1"},{"v":"2"},{"v":"3"},{"v":"7"},{"v":"16"},{"v":"20"}]
SELECT name FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person|Account {id: 1}) RETURN n.name AS name)
=> "Alex"
SELECT name FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person|Account {id: 7}) RETURN n.name AS name)
=> null
SELECT nick_name FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person|Account WHERE n.id = 7) RETURN n.nick_name AS nick_name)
=> "Vacation Fund"
SELECT nick_name FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person|Account WHERE n.id = 1) RETURN n.nick_name AS nick_name)
=> null
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n) WHERE n.id = 7 RETURN LABELS(n) AS result)
=> [{"v":"Account"}]
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n) WHERE n.id = 1 RETURN LABELS(n) AS result)
=> [{"v":"Person"}]
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person|Account WHERE n.name IS NULL) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person|Account WHERE n.id = 999) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "0"
GRAPH scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person|Account) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result
=> "6"

# Node-only paths retain the selected node and its label and properties.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-sql-functions.md
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH p = (n:Person|Account WHERE n.id = 7) RETURN PATH_LENGTH(p) AS result)
=> "0"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH p = (n:Person|Account WHERE n.id = 7) RETURN PATH_FIRST(p).nick_name AS result)
=> "Vacation Fund"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH p = (n:Person|Account WHERE n.id = 1) RETURN PATH_LAST(p).nick_name AS result)
=> null

# Shared variables match element identities, not just the visible property set.
# The two aliases of Person in AliasedNodes have the same keys and properties but distinct identities.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-schema-statements.md
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-patterns.md
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.AliasedNodes MATCH (n) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "6"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.AliasedNodes MATCH (n), (n) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "6"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.AliasedNodes MATCH (n) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT n) AS result)
=> "6"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.AliasedNodes MATCH (n), (m) WHERE SAME(n, m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "6"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n), (n:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"

# The documented unlabeled directed and any-direction edge matches return 8 and 16 rows.
# Reverse traversal and a label union match the same eight directed edges.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-patterns.md
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n)-[e]->(m) RETURN COUNT(e.id) AS result)
=> "8"
GRAPH scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH ()-[e]-() RETURN COUNT(e.id) AS result
=> "16"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n)<-[e]-(m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "8"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person|Account)-[e:Owns|Transfers]->(m:Person|Account) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "8"

# The documented fixture has three ownership edges and five transfers. Properties absent
# from an element table are NULL, including inside the replaced scan's own filter.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-schema-statements.md
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n WHERE n.name IS NOT NULL)-[e]->(m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n WHERE n.name IS NULL)-[e]->(m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "5"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n)-[e WHERE e.amount IS NULL]->(m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n)-[e WHERE e.amount IS NOT NULL]->(m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "5"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n)-[e]->(m) RETURN COUNTIF('Owns' IN UNNEST(LABELS(e))) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n)-[e]->(m) RETURN COUNTIF(n IS SOURCE OF e AND m IS DESTINATION OF e) AS result)
=> "8"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n)<-[e]-(m) RETURN COUNTIF(m IS SOURCE OF e AND n IS DESTINATION OF e) AS result)
=> "8"

# Shared variables and consecutive edges retain table identities across UNION branches.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n)-[e]->(m), (n)-[e]->(m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "8"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person)-[:Owns]->(m)-[e]->(q) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "5"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n)-[:Owns]->(m)-[:Owns]->(q) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "0"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person)-[e]->(m:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "0"

# Named paths retain the common property set and traversal order.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-sql-functions.md
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH p = (n)-[e]->(m) RETURN COUNTIF(PATH_LENGTH(p) = 1) AS result)
=> "8"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH p = (n WHERE n.id = 1)-[e]->(m) RETURN PATH_FIRST(p).name AS result)
=> "Alex"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH p = (n WHERE n.id = 1)-[e]->(m) RETURN PATH_LAST(p).nick_name AS result)
=> "Vacation Fund"

# The small fixture's Knows edges include parallel edges and a self-loop. The loop emits
# once in an any-direction match, but twice between Authors and Readers: those are distinct
# element tables even when their base rows and keys coincide.
# Self-loop deduplication agrees with GoogleSQL's graph_table.test self_edge_deduped.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-patterns.md
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (n)-[e]-(m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "9"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (n)-[e WHERE e.id = 12]-(m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "1"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (n WHERE n.id = 1)-[e]-(m WHERE m.id = 2) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.AliasedNodes MATCH (n)-[e WHERE e.id = 12]-(m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "2"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.AliasedNodes MATCH p = (n)-[e WHERE e.id = 12]-(m) RETURN COUNTIF(IS_ACYCLIC(p)) AS result)
=> "2"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.AliasedNodes MATCH (n)-[e]->(n) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "0"

# Edge table aliases also remain distinct, even when they share their base rows.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-schema-statements.md
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.AliasedEdges MATCH (n)-[e:FirstKnows|SecondKnows]->(m) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT e) AS result)
=> "8"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.AliasedEdges MATCH (n)-[e]->(m), (n)-[e]->(m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "8"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.AliasedEdges MATCH (n)-[e WHERE e.id = 12]-(m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "2"

# Composition with OPTIONAL MATCH preserves a node with no outgoing edges.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (n:Person WHERE n.id = 3) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[e]->(m) RETURN e.id AS result)
=> null

# Bounded repetition composes by element identity across table branches. FinGraph has
# eight one-edge walks and twelve two-edge walks; zero repetitions add its six nodes.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-patterns.md
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n)-[e]->{1,2}(m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "20"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_fingraph.FinGraph MATCH (n)-[e]->{0,2}(m) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "26"
